title: Elegy for a Hollow Man
identity: Cornell’s Malcolm W. Lewis papers identify Elegy for a Hollow Man for solo saxophone and band, including an oversize score. Its archival notes also identify a separate saxophone-and-piano recording, and Frank Bongiorno’s album Classic Saxophone includes the work. Dorn DORN0828 is the catalog’s score lead.
